item.title: Flowise Enterprise Authentication Bypass via Hardcoded Default JWT Secrets (CVE-2026-56271)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.8) — web · CVE-2026-56271 (GHSA-cc4f-hjpj-g9p8). Status: Weaponized (functional PoC forges valid admin JWTs and confirms bypass against real endpoints). Affects: Flowise — open-source low-code LLM/agent orchestration platform (enterprise edition, passport authentication middleware). Tags: flowise, ai-gateway, llm-orchestration, jwt, hardcoded-secret, authentication-bypass, cwe-321, unauthenticated, remote, privilege-escalation.
